answer: Coordination Tariff Ledger. Each agent identity carries a rolling ledger of pairwise coordination events; agents that repeatedly coordinate with the same cluster incur a rising per-event tariff, settled in a scarce resource. Honest agents find a haven in diverse, low-repetition patterns. An attacker steering many identities toward one goal drives every ledger to its nadir, multiplying settlement cost per identity. A sudden gale of coordinated sign-ups triggers the tariff within hours. Cost: each sybil identity pays escalating per-event fees, making N-fold coordination cost superlinear in N.
